composition_label: basic:research -> journey recommendations -> ticket triage & routing

construction.implementation_origin: New implementation authored for this isolated build

shared_schema.input: schema_version, fixture_label, question, sources[{id,title,text,reliability}], actions[{id,title,prerequisites,evidence_terms,category}], completed[action_id], ticket{customer_id,text,severity}, routing{categories:{category:{keywords,team,owner}},fallback_category,priority_by_severity}
shared_schema.output: schema_version, status=ok, fixture_label, research, journey, triage
shared_schema.errors: One stdout JSON object with status=error and error message; exit 2
shared_schema.validation: One validate function enforces input, research, journey, triage and final-envelope boundaries, including grounded citations, prerequisites and accountable ownership.
shared_schema.bounds: 1 MB CLI input; up to 100 sources, actions, categories and string-list items; strings at most 10000 characters; schema version 1; unknown fields rejected.

cross_stage_handoffs.data: Validated exact source excerpts, relevance, reliability and source IDs determine supported actions; citation IDs are preserved.
Validated two-step action IDs vote for categories, blocked status raises the priority floor, source IDs and customer identity are retained.

behavior.research: General-purpose Unicode lexical question/source overlap, exact source quotations, deterministic weighted ranking, max relevance-times-reliability confidence; explicit uncertainty and insufficient-evidence status. Zero-reliability sources are excluded.
behavior.journey: Evidence-term overlap ranks actions. Next actions require completed prerequisites. Searches ranked first actions for a feasible distinct second action; returns exactly two validated steps or an explicit blocked result, never a partial journey.
behavior.triage: Configurable keyword matches plus one category vote per journey step; lexical category tie break and configured fallback. Severity priority is configurable; blocked journeys have at least high priority. Every category requires a team and named owner.
behavior.determinism: No randomness, current time, network calls, model calls or injected LLM is used. Research ties use source ID; action ties use action ID.
behavior.synthetic_data: All example identities, source claims, organizations and support owners are clearly labeled synthetic.

test_outcomes.cli_result: One valid JSON object with status=ok, supported research, ready two-step journey, technical routing and an accountable owner.
coverage: CLI success, missing file, usage, malformed JSON, encoding, duplicate keys and size limit
